ValidationRule.description: VR.CALC.05 — Prevents deletion of Payment Schedule rows that are linked to a non-superseded Calculation Run. The row must be superseded or cancelled before its provenance record can be removed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISNULL(Calculation_Run__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Superseded'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Cancelled') ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Superseded')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Payment Schedule row cannot be deleted because it is linked to an active Calculation Run. Set Status to Superseded or Cancelled first.
